sections.what: Keeps the chosen review type and the three answers in memory. Save shows a short confirmation and clears it after three seconds. Draws the header and the three review tabs.
sections.why: Gives the user the review-type choice and the header. The tabs are the only visible effect of that choice.

sections.name: GoalReviewRituals (part 2)
sections.title: Reflection questions and save button
sections.what: Draws the three text areas for wins, bottlenecks and adjustments, and the Save Reflection Log button with the confirmation text beside it.

sections.watch_out: The confirmation message does not mean that any text was saved.

summary: A reflection form with weekly, monthly and yearly tabs and three text boxes. Its Save button only shows a confirmation message and stores nothing.
purpose: Prompts the user to reflect on wins, friction and next-period adjustments.
why: Likely reason: to encourage regular reviews. Reason for not saving is not stated in the code.
how: Keeps the chosen review type and the three text answers in memory. The tabs change which tab is highlighted. Save shows Reflection Saved for three seconds, then hides it.
inputs: The user's typing and tab choices.
outputs: Only a temporary Reflection Saved message. No data is stored or sent anywhere.
risks: The user will believe reflections are saved, but they are not. Everything typed is lost when the page is left or refreshed.
debug: There is no stored data to check. To add real saving, look at how the store saves other features, since nothing here connects to it. Check the three-second timer if the message stays on screen after leaving the page.
